home.tagline: Offline snakebite triage. No internet. No GPU. No excuses.
home.disclaimer: This app supports — it does not replace — professional medical care. If someone has been bitten, seek emergency help immediately.

identify.cameraPermission: Camera access is required to identify snakes.

settings.privacyBody: No photo or personal data ever leaves your device. Only anonymized, coordinate-truncated encounter metadata is synced.
